description: Single-panel image: a stand-alone FE post-processing contour key (Abaqus-style), with no field map, specimen outline, axes or scale bar included in the supplied crop. The legend header reads "SDV3" with a second line "(Avg: 75%)", i.e. the mapped quantity is solution-dependent state variable 3, nodal-averaged at a 75% threshold. The colour bar consists of thirteen discrete bands running from red at the top through orange, yellow, green and cyan to dark blue at the bottom, each band carrying a printed value on its right; the values decrease monotonically downwards: +8.230e+15, +7.687e+15, +7.144e+15, +6.602e+15, +6.059e+15, +5.516e+15, +4.973e+15, +4.431e+15, +3.888e+15, +3.345e+15, +2.802e+15, +2.260e+15, +1.717e+15. Successive labels differ by ~5.4e+14, so the increments are evenly spaced and the displayed range spans 1.717e+15 to 8.230e+15 of an unstated unit (magnitudes numerically consistent with a dislocation density in m^-2, which the caption does not confirm). The panel therefore only documents the colour-to-value mapping used to render the SDV3 field in the accompanying Johnson-Cook/warm multiaxial-forging simulation; the spatial distribution of SDV3 cannot be read from these pixels.
measured_quantities: SDV3 (solution-dependent state variable 3, contour-averaged; unit not stated, range 1.717e+15 to 8.230e+15)

observations.observation: The legend header reads 'SDV3' and a second line reads '(Avg: 75%)', identifying the plotted quantity as solution-dependent state variable 3 with 75% nodal averaging.
The colour bar has thirteen discrete bands, from red at the top through orange, yellow, green and cyan to dark blue at the bottom.
The highest printed value on the bar is +8.230e+15 and is associated with the top red band.
The lowest printed value on the bar is +1.717e+15 and is associated with the bottom dark blue band.
Consecutive printed values differ by approximately 5.4e+14, so the legend increments are evenly spaced.
No unit is printed for SDV3 anywhere on the panel.
No contour field map, specimen outline, axis, or scale bar appears in the supplied image; only the colour key is present.

The 'Avg: 75%' annotation is the standard finite-element post-processor notation for the percentage of elements/nodes averaged into a nodal contour value, indicating this key belongs to a numerical simulation result rather than measured data.
